name: character-passport
description: Cast an AI video before anything moves: for every character and hero prop, a passport (one paragraph, every visible detail, pasted word for word into every prompt), a turnaround sheet in the moodboard's look, six expressions written as cause + physical tells, a measured voice line (pace in words per minute, accent, one verbal habit), and for props the materials, wear and how they move and sound. Includes anti-slop design rules, a prompt builder that refuses paraphrased passports, code routes (three.js, VRM, SVG face rig) and tested reference sites. Use for "make a character", "consistent character", "character sheet", "turnaround", "character bible", "expression sheet", "voice for my character", "prop sheet", "same person in every shot", or characters that look generic, plastic or different from shot to shot. Not for category looks (varg-character-design), real actor photos in multi-scene ads (varg-consistent-characters) or the film's look (video-moodboard).
